events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A New Heir

options.text: My legacy has been secured.

events.text: At the announcement of the heir's birth, celebrations erupt in the capital of [city]. People gather in the streets to toast [character] and revel in the hope of a bright future. May [character] grow and prosper!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Terrible Loss

options.text: I will not let grief be my undoing.

events.text: Your beloved husband, [character], has died. After a vigil attended by close friends and family, you retire to your chambers. The coming nights will be lonely, but you will persist with the support of your loved ones. [character] will be missed.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Affairs of the People

options.text: You are powerful and therefore above petty politics.
Politics is a noble profession if you stay true to your principles.

events.text: After a youth spent watching you in court, your son [character] wishes to participate in politics. He believes that years of study have prepared him for this responsibility. "I am ready to work and to serve." How do you reply?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Amulet of Fertility

options.text: I must get rid of this amulet at once.
Turn the key, and give it to my beloved [character].
Lock the amulet, and give it to my beloved [character].
I would rather sell the trinket.

events.text: Moments after your son's birth, one of the servants who assisted in the delivery approaches you. She presses a battered but bejeweled locket into your hand. It can be locked and unlocked with a tiny key. "To remain fruitful, simply turn the key," she says. "But to slow the seed, you must lock it." You don't know what to make of the woman's strange utterance, but the amulet does look valuable.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Big Questions

options.text: A life of curiosity will serve you well.
We are all at the mercy of the divine.
Perhaps humanity must forge its own path.

events.text: After a visit to an ascetic retreat, your son [character] returns to the palace moved by his experiences. He wonders about the role of humanity in the greater cosmos, unsure if a person should question their place or submit to a higher authority. He asks about your views on religion and philosophy.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Blessings for the Heir

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: [character] would benefit from spiritual guidance.
Letting [character] study alongside [religion] wise men would be of great help.
He should learn to inspire the people as [religion] priests inspire their followers.

events.text: As a gesture of [religion] support for your royal line, [character] comes to the palace, offering to publicly bless [character] as the heir to the [rival] throne who will one day become the leader of the greatest [religion] land. [character] asks if there is anything else the [religion] community can do to make [character] better prepared to take the throne. What support will you request for your heir?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Child of Prophecy

options.text: Listen closely to the old beggar's words of wisdom.
Ignore the fool and toss him back into the street.

events.text: As servants carry [character], the newborn heir, to be bathed, a strange old beggar wanders into the court from the busy street. He falls to his knees before the swaddled babe, weeping into his cracked and filthy fingers. "This is the child of prophecy," the beggar declares. "All [rival]'s fortunes are to tied to his."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Coming of Age

options.text: Conduct a traditional [rival] ceremony.
Commission new regalia for [character].
Declare a national holiday in [city].

events.text: Rejoice! Your heir, [character], has become an adult in the eyes of [rival] law. How shall we mark this occasion?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Common Love

options.text: Family and lineage come first. Always.
Follow your heart and find happiness.
Thank the heavens! It seems [character] was heir to an ancient title all along!

events.text: Your son [character] is acting... odd. He laughs at nothing, writes poetry, and spends hours gazing into the warm glow of sunset. One day, he reveals the truth. He is in love... with a commoner.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Complications

options.text: The court has more important matters to consider.
Wisdom demands that we change our ways.
Propose a new marriage for [character].
Give [character] whatever is required.
We will honor [character] with a city-wide celebration.

events.text: Weeks of misery and physical agony end on an overcast morning, when [character] gives birth. Sadly, he does not survive the experience. His husband, [character], passes the days in dignified mourning. One day, [character] arrives in court alongside several women from his household staff. He proposes that we spend more effort to understand the process of giving birth and its complications, including new methods of safe delivery.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Dark Omens

options.text: Sacrifice cows to our chief god.
Build a great ritual fire to ward off evil.
Do nothing, this is mere superstition.

events.text: Your newborn, [character], arrives in the dead of night during a howling rainstorm. The mystics of the court view this event as a very bad omen, and they warn us of coming turmoil. What should we do?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: End of an Era

options.text: Farewell, [character].

events.text: Following the announcement of our former [title] [character]'s death, [rival] takes a moment to unite and remember his life and rule.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Enlistment

options.text: He must go and fight for what he believes in.
Any child of mine must be a leader.
There are safer ways for him to fight.

events.text: Tired of waiting for permission, your son [character] enlists in the military. The time has come to fight for the common good. He is leaving with or without your blessing.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: False Accusation

options.text: Throw them out of the court.
Convince them of their mistake.
Turn them against each other.

events.text: As you and your son [character] entertain visiting dignitaries from [rival], an argument breaks out. The visitors accuse you of installing spies in their court. The claims are false, of course, but your reaction will set a strong example for young [character].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Farewell, Brother

options.text: I will miss [character].

events.text: It pains the court to bring you news of your brother's untimely death. The capital mourns. May the soul of [character] find eternal rest.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Child Of Leader Dead Us
Not Spouse Of Leader Dead Us
events.name: Final Remembrance

options.text: Record him as a keen and generous patron of the arts.
He was a friend of the people, a part of the community.
As a holy and pious devotee to, one to be celebrated and honored.
Ask to be left to your grief.

events.text: The funerary procession for [character] stretches back to the capital as mourners wail and beat their breasts. You are approached by a delegation of the [religion] leaders, who want to indelibly record the life of the deceased believer in their annals. How should [character] be remembered?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Fragile

options.text: Science must hold a solution.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: We will rely on divine protection.

events.text: Your family basks in the warmth of a new life. However, court doctors soon notice that your son [character] appears to suffer from unique physical challenges. They are concerned for his ongoing health and development. How will you respond to their worries?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Funeral Procession

options.text: It is the family's responsibility to honor him.
We will pay the appropriate respects.
I will ride in [character]'s stead.

events.text: Following the death of [character], his family has arranged a funeral procession to honor his military career. They have hired actors to don the masks of his ancestors, and they need a figure to ride in the rear wearing [character]'s triumphal regalia. The court does not usually pay for such commemoration, but [character] was beloved by the people.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Funerary Games

options.text: The armour belongs to [character].
[character] is the victor.
Such magnificent armor should be mine!

events.text: Inspired by the tales of heroes of old, the [family] have decided to hold funeral games for [character]. After a ritual to honor, champions from the different houses compete in matches of archery, wrestling and racing chariots. Most contested prize is a suit of armor commissioned by the [family], showing the feats of. The choice is left to you who to gift it to, with [character] and [character] having each performed exceptionally well in the competition.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Holy War

options.text: Remove these sects... discreetly.
[character] is unfit for the throne.
It is true, the savages must be destroyed.

events.text: Your heir, the passionate [character], gives a stirring, vicious speech to court. He has fallen in with fiery sects on the outskirts of the capital. These madmen have been urging war against the savage [tribe], no matter what the cost. [character] demands action, but the court worries that your legacy may be stained by such mania.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Honored by the Faith

options.text: Refuse to trade pleasantries with the sanctimonious [title].

events.text: [character] is dead, and the court fills with people for his funerary rites. [character] oversees the proceedings, a high honor as [character] was renowned as an especially devout [religion] follower. After the rites, [character] approaches you, without the usual entourage of. Will you use this chance to get close to the [title]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: In the Hands of

options.text: Offer to buy this treasure from the clergy.
Have the item confiscated and brought to the palace.
Stay your hand and leave it to pass on to the temple, as intended.

events.text: Upon the death of [character], you hear whispers that his [trait] has been left to his favored [religion] temple. An unbidden thought comes to mind: will the really be able to make good use of such a rare and valuable item? Is such a relic not more fit for a [title]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Joy and Pain

options.text: I will marry again for the good of the nation.
I am not ready to give my heart to another.

events.text: Days after the birth of your healthy baby son, [character], your beloved [character] begins to feel the toll of the ordeal. She weakens, slips into a fitful sleep, and dies without any pain. Your ministers advise you to take another wife soon, to maintain continuity, but your heart aches...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Keepsake

options.text: Let go and avoid holding on to such material possessions.
Keep it on you to remember him by.
Dedicate it in a prayer for [character].

events.text: After [character] death, you find a small keepsake, a small amulet with and your name etched in on the back. It is such a tiny thing but the burnished metal feels warm to the touch, as if he had just been holding it.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Laid to Rest

options.text: I must endure the loss and live on.

events.text: [character] has died. [rival] mourns, as it lays to rest your beloved husband. The King will never be forgotten.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Lands of the Dead

options.text: Lead the rites yourself.
Delegate to the.

events.text: [character] is dead, his body prepared by the <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_RELIGION_GREECE>women<else><end> of [religion] for the journey into the next life. <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_RELIGION_ASSYRIA>There is no judgment after death, just the cold and dark planes of existence where the dead wander for eternity sustained by naught but clay. It is a grim fate that awaits all people, and the rites serve a powerful reminder to make the most of your time upon the earth.<p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_BABYLONIA>There is no judgment after death, just the cold and dark planes of existence where the dead wander for eternity sustained by naught but clay. It is a grim fate that awaits all people, and the rites serve a powerful reminder to make the most of your time upon the earth. <p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_CARTHAGE>The dead is first anointed with perfumed resin, colored red with ocher and cinnabar, before being burned or buried. A feast is a final send-off for the dead, a banquet in the cemetery with the ritually impure crockery smashed and buried at the end of the meal. <p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_EGYPT>After the ritual preparation of the body, there is a complex journey to be undertaken, with the ka, the deceased’s double in death, making the journey through the judgment of Osiris and the weighing of the heart. Only then will they reach the Field of Reeds, living for eternity with the servants and goods buried together in death.<p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_GREECE>The body is prepared by the women of the family, with the Priests unable to enter the house tainted by death. A coin is placed in the mouth of the deceased, with which to pay the ferryman of Hades, Charon. After passing into Hades a dutiful soul will find themselves in Elysium, the wicked fall to Tartarus. Libations from the living are an important duty to help the dead, as the forgotten souls are lost, wandering the fields of Hades for eternity.<p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_HITTITE>There are many thoughts of what follows death, but none of them are reassuring. The fourteen day ritual prepares the dead to take their rightful place, the burning of the body on the second day followed by further rituals and sacrifices to guide the soul along the journey in which he tries to avoid the ‘dark earth’.<p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_PERSIA>After death, it is thought that the person’s spirit wanders the earth for three days. During this time it is up to the family to provide help through rituals and sacrifices to guard the spirit from harm. <p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_ROME>The body must be burned and interred before it is thought that the shade of the dead is able to leave the world of the living and cross the river Styx. A ritual feast with the living is the final sign for the deceased that they can continue on and that the family will be able to move forwards.<else>The rituals are ready and the body prepared.<end> The want to know, will you organize the full funerary rites for [character]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Love Kills

options.text: Decry such heartless accusations!
Stay silent in the face of such lies.
Turn the charges back on [character].

events.text: At the funeral for [character], [character] has accused you, without evidence, of orchestrating the recent death of your spouse. He charges you with plotting this murder to clear a path to legitimacy for your true love, a priestess in one of the local temples. Obviously, the charge is false, but it could still harm your reputation.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Midwives

options.text: Create a school for training midwives.
Find more doctors to treat the sick and infirm.

events.text: Following the healthy delivery of your beloved [character], your wife touts the remarkable skills of the women who assisted at the birth. Medical training for midwives could be a boon, but some in court still believe doctors to be the only solution.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Natal Astrologer

options.text: Brave.
Cunning.
Prosperous.

events.text: A court astrologer attends the birth of your new son, and she prepares a reading of celestial bodies as a gift for the newborn. According to the signs, your child [character] will grow to become...

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: New Life

outcomes.label: New Ambition Two Max Level Unit

rewards.text: Progress ambition: Two Max Level Unit

outcomes.label: New Ambition Two Max Level Unit

rewards.text: Progress ambition: Two Max Level Unit

outcomes.label: New Ambition Two Max Level Unit

rewards.text: Progress ambition: Two Max Level Unit

options.text: I'm not feeling very ambitious right now.

events.text: As you look into the eyes of your newborn child [character], you feel an unrivaled sense of possibility. You are inspired to new heights of glory and courage! What Ambition will you choose as the outlet for these newfound energies?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: New Thoughts

options.text: My royal bloodline is all that matters.
I want to live in a world of peace and beauty.
Family is the only treasure worth pursuing.

events.text: The birth of your son [character] has inspired you to see the world in a new light! More than ever, you wish to make the most of your time on this mortal plane. What is most important in life?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Omens of Your End

rewards.text: Gain trait: Abandoned To The Elements

options.text: Order [character] to abandon [character] to the elements.
Await fate.

events.text: You have, of late, been troubled by dreams of one who will destroy you, [rival], and all you have worked for. Now these dreams have become all too specific: it is the young [character] that you are now certain is destined to unravel everything.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Paternity

options.text: We will find someone to adopt this baby.
You will raise the baby and marry the girl.

events.text: A sheepish [character] comes to you with a serious dilemma... He is going to be a father. You do not know the girl who carries your unborn grandson, but your son appears to care for her greatly. However, there is more than love to consider. There is lineage. There is honor.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Petty Crimes

options.text: You must repay all those you have wronged.
You are royalty and must answer to no one.
You will make a public apology before the court.

events.text: Outside the court, you discover your son [character] being dragged down the street in chains. He is accused of a series of petty crimes: theft, bribery, and destruction of property. Once [character] has been released, he asks about his punishment.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Prepare your Heir

options.text: Let him rule for a day.
Take him on a hunt.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Mounted
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Mounted

options.text: Show him the farthest borders of the realm.

events.text: Your heir, [character], has reached adulthood, causing you to reflect on his years of growth and training. How will you prepare him for the throne?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Renewed Hope

options.text: A caregiver and tutor will shape his early years.
The closeness and loyalty of a pet will bring joy.
We will try to provide him with more siblings.

events.text: The birth of young [character] lays to rest any worries about your legacy. You wish to provide the new heir with every comfort and opportunity, ensuring that he will grow to become a legendary leader of [rival]. What will benefit the child at this young age?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Returned by Grace

options.text: Accept [character] into your court.
Turn away the young soldier.

events.text: After [character] funeral rites, you are approached by a young man who claims to be the courtier's long lost son. The [religion] disciple believes that it is's will that he serves you as his father did before. Will you accept [character] service?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Royal Birth

options.text: Collect gifts from the noble families.
Send commemorative coins to all nobles.
Present [character] to the adoring public.

events.text: Your heart swells with joy, as you gaze down upon your newborn son, [character]. This is a momentous occasion. How should we celebrate the royal birth?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Secrets of the Dead

options.text: Reveal the truth.
Agree to keep this secret and swear the to silence.
Use this information to control the [family].

events.text: Soon after news of [character] death arrives, your Spymaster [character] slides out of the shadows with information about the deceased. Messages found after the death have revealed that [character] had a rather more intimate relationship with [character] than was commonly known. [character] quickly confesses when confronted and begs for your help. The two lovers were meeting under the guise of [religion] worship, blackmailing into silence. Now the clergy are threatening to expose the crimes of the dead.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: See the World

options.text: The world is beautiful and full of wonders.
Scout our enemies, and report back to me.
Seek of the edge of this earth... and beyond.
You must stay here safe with us.

events.text: Even as a child, your son [character] possessed a faraway gaze, a desire to explore the world. So it is no surprise when he asks your permission to join a scouting mission. You hope [character] will always remember your parting words.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Showered with Gifts

options.text: Accept gifts from the [family] family.
Accept gifts from the [family] family.
Accept gifts from the [family] family.
Accept gifts from all the families.

events.text: All [rival] rejoices at the news of a new heir! Your legacy is secure... for now. The vassal families wish to visit the child and bestow gifts upon him. This may be an opportunity to play favorites.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Speaking His Mind

options.text: No apologies necessary. [character] does not know any better.
This horrid behavior is a reflection on the [rival] royal family.
[character] is right, [character] was an oafish goat.

events.text: The great [character] has died. Leaders from many nations attend the funeral, including the [rival] royal family. As the young [rival] heir, [character], consumes more than his share of wine, he becomes quite outspoken, calling the deceased a "hideous wretch" and an "oafish goat." He even makes veiled threats against the surviving court. Mortified by such behavior, [character] scolds [character], ordering him to apologize. The [title] begs your forgiveness.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Strong Opinions

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: The people are ours to rule as we see fit.
We must try to seek justice for everyone.
All that matters is how YOU will lead.

events.text: While passing the chambers of your son, [character], you overhear him criticizing the court, specifically your leadership. Interrupting politely, you offer to explain your choices, and to educate him in the challenges of governing. Skeptical, [character] listens to your philosophy.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Birthday Gift

options.text: Treat money like you have plenty of it.
Riches are required to play the role of ruler.
Count every coin like it is your last.

events.text: A wealthy merchant has sent a cache of jewels to your son [character] in celebration of his birthday. Before making a purchase with this newfound wealth, he asks your opinion about handling money.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Calling

options.text: The church only wishes to control you.

fields: aeRandomTraitDelay: TRAIT_BLESSED, TRAIT_INSPIRING, TRAIT_PIOUS, TRAIT_ASCETIC, TRAIT_INSANE

options.text: Yes, you have been chosen by the gods.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: It is wise to explore your spirituality.

events.text: Always a searcher, your son [character] expresses an interest in the beliefs of [religion]. He has hosted philosophers and holy men at the palace, seeking instruction in his faith. Privately, [character] asks if you believe he has been "called."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Court Mourns

options.text: He served us well.

events.text: Today, we grieve the death of [character], a member of the [rival] court. His spirit will be venerated and his deeds will be remembered. The nation mourns.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Cult of [character]

options.text: Name him as the guardian deity of [city].
Build a sanctuary complex as impressive as any gods'.
Encourage the [family] to raise shrines to honor him.

events.text: Although not as highly regarded as the gods, the heroes of [rival] still deserve praise. Upon the death of [character], a cult has arisen around the fallen man, with people making sacrifices and effigies dedicated to the hero. The of [religion] have ratified this decision, decreeing that the gods wish for [character] to be given the honors of a hero. Will you encourage this worship of the fallen?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Final Favor

options.text: Accept a sizeable donation to your national coffers.
Ask that he keep the favor for the time being.

events.text: At the funeral of [character], you are approached by [character]. "I owed a debt to [character], and was not able to repay it. Allow me to repay you in his honor instead. Will you accept?"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Fire Defiled

options.text: Let Mithra judge him.
He is lost already. Further rituals will not help.

events.text: [character] of the [family] family has gone against the teachings of [religion] and been burned after death. For fire to be defiled by anything, let alone an impure dead body, is a grave sin. The [family] are asking to have the normal [religion] state rituals to guide [character] to the Bridge of the Separator, but [character] is telling the Magi to withhold the rites. Do you intervene?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Necropolis

options.text: Include a comprehensive record of his achievements.
Conduct funerary rites with quiet dignity.

events.text: After the completion of Necropolis in [city], it is time to inter our last ruler, [character]. How shall his life be memorialized?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Puppies

options.text: He is my blood, there is nothing I can do.
The military will understand how to deal with him.
Send him to a home for the sick.

events.text: After hearing some disturbing rumors, servants discover your son [character] in a crawl space of the stables, where he has strangled a litter of puppies. For fun. When confronted, [character] refuses to confess.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Tower of Silence

options.text: We will be left on the Tower of Silence.
No, traditional [rival] burial is the right of our Kings.

events.text: The Magi form a somber procession. Careful not to touch the lifeless body of [character], they carry him out of the city to be left for the birds and wolves to claim before the bones are gathered. The images are still playing in your mind when a messenger arrives from [character]. Your royal line have so far kept to traditional [rival] burial practices despite adopting [religion] as the State Religion. [character] urges you to embrace the [religion] way of burial, so that the contamination of the body is not left to mix with the other dead. Will you keep the royal tradition when you are lain to rest or will you accept new ways?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Twins

options.text: We are truly blessed!

events.text: You have been blessed with not one, but two children. Soon after [character] is born another follows. The of [religion] exclaim that twins are a sign of divine favor and in such cases, one of the infants is likely the offspring of.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Wise Investments

options.text: Our cities overflow with the poor and hungry.
You should keep the fruits of your own labor.

events.text: Your son [character] is barely able to contain his excitement! He made several wise business investments with city merchants, and his profits far exceeded expectations. Wanting to please you, [character] asks how he should use this windfall.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: With Child

options.text: There will be no baby without a marriage.
You and your child are no longer my blood.
The baby will live, but at my whim.

events.text: You learn, via your husband, [character], that [character] carries your unborn grandchild. It was not a planned pregnancy. As ruler, matters of bloodline and legitimacy must go through you. A baby would bring much to celebrate, but many would question the child's lineage and birthright.
